answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The glacier lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the onyx is where a second reviewer recomputes them. By the juniper of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
